name: Third Party non-compliance (supply chain)
description: Threats from unvetted, of insufficiently monitored third parties a satellite's the supply chain which may result in the development and delivery of specific components that fail to comply or live up to the security specifications and requiurements that have access to sensitive data or are intended to support critical satellite functions. Examples include use of counterfeit or copied software (e.g. pirated software) that may contain malware, such as disk wiper malware, or the provision of hardware components that contian back doors.
